_comment: Czech (resident) issuers whose NACE and ESA come from RES (core.classify.residents),
graded on the proposal with the model off. The table of Jakub's brief (2 Oct 2026):
legal entities only, never natural persons. RES fields as ARES returned them on
2 Oct 2026; expected_esa is the BA0036 resident code of core.codebooks.res_esa.
verified_by stays empty until someone checks a case - like the foreign cases.
tie: the codes the rules leave to MO (or the model) when no register records the
institution type; expected_esa must be one of them.

cases.subject: ČEZ, a. s.
cases.note: By ISIN: GLEIF's registeredAs gives the IČO. Public non-financial corporation (state majority).

cases.subject: Energetický a průmyslový holding, a.s.
cases.note: A holding's head office: RES says 70 (activities of head offices) - roadmap Q15 answered by the register for residents.

cases.subject: ČESKÁ NÁRODNÍ BANKA
cases.note: The central bank: a sector without a control axis.

cases.subject: Komerční banka, a.s.
cases.note: S.122 under foreign control; the ECB MFI list (credit institution, by LEI) makes it a bank.

cases.subject: Raiffeisenbank a.s.
cases.note: By IČO: GLEIF by registeredAs gives the LEI the ECB MFI list knows.

cases.subject: Fio banka, a.s.
cases.note: A national private bank: RES's control digit 2.

cases.subject: ING Bank N.V.
cases.note: The Prague branch (odštěpný závod) has no LEI, so the ECB MFI list cannot be asked by LEI: bank and other deposit-taker tie. The MFI list carries it as credit institution CZ49279866 (RIAD = CZ + IČO), like all 20 foreign-bank branches in CZ - a follow-up could match on that.

cases.subject: Artesa, spořitelní družstvo
cases.note: Legal form 205 (družstvo) in S.122: a savings and credit cooperative, though it is a credit institution on the MFI list too.

cases.subject: ČSOB Leasing, a.s.
cases.note: S.125 subtype by the NACE class: 64.91 financial leasing = lender (t = 3).

cases.subject: Home Credit a.s.
cases.note: S.125, 64.92 other credit granting = lender; control national private (2).

cases.subject: Burza cenných papírů Praha, a.s.
cases.note: Market infrastructure: S.126 under foreign control.

cases.subject: Kooperativa pojišťovna, a.s., Vienna Insurance Group
cases.note: RES spells the prevailing code with three digits (651): the division is still 65.

cases.subject: Ministerstvo financí
cases.note: A Czech government bond: GLEIF maps no ISIN, ESMA FIRDS names the LEI of Česká republika - Ministerstvo financí (registeredAs 00006947, RA000168).

cases.subject: Česká exportní banka, a.s.
cases.note: RES files it in central government (13110), the ECB MFI list as a credit institution: RES wins and the page notes the disagreement - for MO to confirm, like Národní rozvojová banka (13110, MFI) and EGAP (13110, ECB insurers).
